answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 37988 Country: Pakistan Title: zakat on invested money Question: I have invested 8 lac in a buissness. I want to know do I have to pay zakat on invested money? Answer ID: 37988 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! Fatwa: 630/541/B=1433 Yes, you will have pay zakah (2.5% annually) on the money invested in business. If you have gained some profit, zakah shall be wajib on the profit as well. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
